title: NCERT introduces 20-hour AI module for classes 9-12, covers deepfakes and data privacy
summary: NCERT has introduced a 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for Classes 9-12, aligned with NEP 2020 and developed with experts from IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur. The five-unit curriculum covers machine learning, deepfakes, AI hallucinations, digital safety and effective prompting.

title: PHP cyber glitch: Former POTUS Barack Obama cyber chief explains why AI finding software flaws is ‘tech debt coming due’
summary: Former White House cybersecurity coordinator under US President Barack Obama said the PHP episode marked the beginning of a “pretty chaotic period”.

title: Amazon AWS cloud capacity sold out through 2027, Andy Jassy says amid AI boom
summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says AWS cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with a significant portion of 2028 capacity already booked amid surging AI demand.
